quote.author: XFreeze
quote.name: X Freeze
quote.text:
Elon Musk just revealed that Tesla is building a research chip fab at Gigafactory Texas that could reduce semiconductor development cycles from one year to just one month

That's a potential 12 TIMES increase in the speed of chip development

Tesla is building two semiconductor facilities in Texas with distinct purposes:

• Giga Texas, Austin — A research fab for experimenting with new chip designs, fabrication techniques and manufacturing processes

• Terafab, Grimes County — A massive production facility where successful breakthroughs will be scaled into high-volume chip manufacturing

The research fab aims to bring the entire chip development process under one roof:

• Logic fabrication
• Memory fabrication
• Lithography
• Advanced packaging
• Chip testing

Instead of relying on lengthy development cycles spread across multiple facilities, Tesla is working toward designing, manufacturing and testing complete chips in approximately ONE MONTH

That means potentially 12 development cycles in the time it traditionally takes to complete one

Tesla is building the ability to develop its own chips, manufacture them and continuously improve them at a pace the semiconductor industry has rarely seen

Elon Musk says the lack of popularity for data centers is temporary because of the prosperity that is brought by them:

"The lack of popularity is where there aren't data centers  and they think a data center will have a bad effect. Memphis is booming because of @SpaceX. The restaurants are full, the hotels are full, we're paying twice the prevailing wage people were earning before. We've also helped local schools. I think this popularity thing is a temporary concern because there actually is tremendous prosperity that is brought by the data centers. Talk to the people in town and they feel it because their businesses are booming."

(via 33rd Annual Baron Investment Conference today in NYC)

posts.author: elonmusk
posts.text:
Elon Musk just confirmed that SpaceX is preparing to attempt the FIRST-EVER tower catch of a Starship upper stage with Ship 42 in about ONE WEEK

SpaceX has already achieved multiple precise, controlled soft landings of Starship in the ocean

Elon revealed that these landings were so accurate that if a catch tower had been positioned at those locations, Starship would have been caught

But bringing a massive spacecraft back to the actual launch tower requires an entirely different level of confidence

SpaceX has been working to ensure the ship is reliable enough to return without damaging the tower or putting people at risk from falling debris

And SpaceX reached that point

Ship 42 is being prepared for the first attempt to catch a Starship upper stage with the launch tower

And there's another interesting detail

Elon highlighted that 42 is a special number, making Ship 42 a fitting vehicle for this historic attempt

This is the breakthrough Starship needs to achieve FULL AND RAPID REUSABILITY

For the first time ever, SpaceX is preparing to bring the entire Starship rocket back for recovery using its launch tower

quote.author: KanekoaTheGreat
quote.name: KanekoaTheGreat
quote.text:
Elon Musk says Cloudflare is underestimating how much AI agents will take over the internet.

MUSK: “Agentic internet traffic already exceeds human traffic... Cloudflare predicted that in five years, agentic AI traffic will be a thousand times more than human traffic. And if anything, I think that is underestimating.”

Ron Baron, whose firm is a major SpaceX investor, says he has modeled Starlink at $1 trillion in revenue and a $14–15 trillion valuation within 10 years, and now thinks that’s “really light.”

MUSK: “Starlink revenue is growing very rapidly... roughly doubling revenues per year at large scale. I remember when that used to be a big deal.”

Every AI agent needs bandwidth and compute. SpaceX is building both.
